name: search-box
summary: A compact search-entry pattern built on a native `<input type="search">`. Mirrors the [Web-ODS Shared Library → Search box](https://www.figma.com/design/0o8SL5BEk8wHtgud00dRyg/Web-ODS-Shared-Library?node-id=698-47669&m=dev) (`698:47669`) under the other brand mode pick. The native HTML intentionally diverges from the Figma div tree — visual + token fidelity is the bar.

properties.name: size
properties.description: Drives the control min-block size + input text size. Mirrors the Figma `Size` property (M = 32, L = 40).

properties.name: iconFirst
properties.description: Lead with the search glyph + separator, or trail them after the input. Mirrors the Figma `Icon first` property.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Initial value; a non-empty value reveals the clear button.

properties.name: accessibleLabel
properties.description: Bound to the input `aria-label` (the search box has no visible `<label>`).

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disables the input + clear button and paints the disabled surface.

variants.values: `m` (32px control, `body-sm` input text) / `l` (40px control, `body-base` input text).
`true` (search glyph + separator lead the input) / `false` (they trail it, via the `--icon-last` modifier).
`empty` / `hover` / `focused` / `typing` — pseudo-class driven (`:hover` / `:focus-within`) plus the `is-filled` modifier that reveals the clear button.

accessibility: The input carries an `aria-label` (default "Search") since the search box ships no visible `<label>`.
The clear button is a real `<button type="button">` with an `aria-label` ("Clear search"); pressing it empties the field and returns focus to the input.
The native UA search-cancel button (`::-webkit-search-cancel-button`) is suppressed; the styled clear button replaces it so the affordance exists and is reachable in Firefox too.
Focus ring uses `:focus-within` on the wrapper so the whole control reads as one focus target; `:focus-visible` keeps the clear-button ring keyboard-only.

WCAG: resting + focus borders meet AA non-text contrast against `--color-bg-input`; the glyph + separator are `aria-hidden`. Per the Figma guidance frame (`984:2201`), keep search boxes on the primary background where border contrast is guaranteed.
